title: Notices
subtitle: Post notices for your residents and record days when food isn't served.

notice.deleteConfirm: Delete this notice? Residents will no longer see it.
notice.deleteConfirmLinked: Delete this notice? The food holiday stays; only the notice is removed.
notice.emptyDesc: Notices you post show up here, and in the resident app once it's ready.
notice.errActionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.

outdated.title: This notice may be out of date
outdated.body: The food holiday changed after this text was written. Check that the dates and details still read right.

form.titleTooLong: The title can be at most {max} characters.
form.expiresHint: Optional. Leave empty to keep it up.
form.expiryInPast: Choose today or a later day.
form.autoTextHint: Editing the text stops this notice from following the food holiday automatically. You'll be told if the holiday changes later.
form.errSaveFailed: Couldn't save the notice. Please try again.

holidays.intro: A food holiday is a stretch of days when residents can stay but no food is served. You can credit the food charge on their next bill.
holidays.emptyDesc: Add a festival or any other days when food won't be served. Residents are told on the notice board.
holidays.noticeOutdated: The notice for this holiday may be out of date. Review it.

holidayForm.name: Name
holidayForm.endBeforeStart: The last day can't be before the first day.
holidayForm.tooLong: A holiday can be at most {max} days long.
holidayForm.dayCount: {count, plural, one {# day, no food} other {# days, no food}}
holidayForm.adjust: Adjust food charges in the next bill
holidayForm.adjustHint: Each resident with food gets a credit for the holiday days they were here, once the holiday is over.
holidayForm.rateRequired: Enter the food charge per day.
holidayForm.rateInvalid: Enter an amount up to 999999.99 with at most two decimals.
holidayForm.rateNoDefault: No default set. You can set one in the property's settings.
holidayForm.postNoticeHint: Adds a notice for this holiday to the notice board. It updates itself if you change the holiday.
holidayForm.lockedNote: This holiday is already on an issued bill or a settlement, so its dates, rate and bill adjustment can't change. You can still rename it.
holidayForm.errSaveFailed: Couldn't save the food holiday. Please try again.

detail.notFound: This food holiday no longer exists.
detail.errActionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
detail.deleteLocked: This holiday is already on an issued bill or a settlement, so it can't be deleted.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this food holiday? Any credit waiting on a draft bill is removed.
detail.deleteConfirmWithNotice: Delete this food holiday? Any credit waiting on a draft bill is removed, and so is its notice, unless you edited the notice text.
detail.noNotice: No notice was posted for this holiday. You can post one from the Notices tab.
detail.notAdjustedNote: This holiday isn't credited on bills.

credits.empty: No resident qualifies for a credit yet.
credits.estimatedLegend: Estimated: this resident qualifies now, but nothing is credited until the holiday is over and a bill is drafted. Estimates, waived credits and clawbacks are not part of the credited total.
